title: Planar multilinks and rational singularities
summary: Fibered multilinks are a generalization of classical fibered knots and open books that arise in the study of surface singularities and Milnor fibrations. We prove that if the canonical contact structure on the link of a surface singularity is supported by a planar multilink open book, then the singularity must be rational, and that sandwiched singularities are characterized by admitting planar multilinks with a component of multiplicity 1.
